svg.title: Measured pre-boot packed MFD END comparison
svg.desc: Four fresh END1 probes preserve packed-source component correspondence and show PICTURE_SYNC LAST_PIXEL at observation15. END0 references show no LAST_PIXEL within17 observations. Sequential scalar reads are not a completion or accepted-output certificate.

g.text: Packed MFD END1 profile: LAST_PIXEL observed
BCM70015 · pre-boot, signed payload staged but never booted · four fresh probes: A, B, A′, B′
Same 96-byte prefix, STRIDE0, CTRL5 and HSIZE8. MFD setup difference from #229: vertical END literal 0 → 1.
Qualified initial raw pair: HSIZE=00000780, VERTICAL=00000436; guards pin (780,436) → (8,436) → (8,1).
The zero-required profile refused this pair twice before custom writes. Reset-default semantics remain unproved.
A / A′: END1 measured fields
B / B′: END1 measured fields
END0 references (#229): one extra sampled ordinal
Y field (10-bit)
Observation ordinal / host pulse-pair attempts
Alternating chroma field (10-bit)
Observation ordinal / host pulse-pair attempts
All 64 sampled Y/C pairs match source octets ×4; each probe shows two 8-value cycles. A′=A and B′=B for all raw tuples.
PICTURE_SYNC labels in SAMPLE and TAP agree
END0
END1
0=normal, 1=FIRST_PIXEL, 2=LAST_PIXEL. END1 stops at ordinal15; ordinal16 is not read.
END0 reference: 17 observations · 16 host pairs · 42 target attempts · FEED.LINE_COUNT=1 · LAST not observed.
END1: 16 observations · 15 host pairs · 40 target attempts · FEED.LINE_COUNT=2 · LAST_PIXEL2 only at ordinal15.
Both: READY1 / ACCEPT0; LAST_LINE0; EOF not observed. Defined feeder-error bits remain zero.
Four deliberate pre-CMAC aborts and stock cleanups succeeded; normal MPEG-2 / H.264 recovery is checked separately.
Bounds count host attempts, not accepted transfers. Post-W9 raw8 does not prove pulse/latch semantics.
Sequential CSR reads are not atomic. Source units/extent/lease, downstream output and completion remain unproved.
